article.title: Banana Splits May Improve Eyesight
article.author: Dr. Sundae
article.featured_img_alt: A banana split topped with whipped cream and cherries
article.content:
Can a banana split help you see the bright side? Our completely informal taste test says yes.

After enjoying bananas, three scoops, whipped cream, and a cherry, participants reported that the whole day looked better. Scientists may call that happiness rather than improved eyesight, but the results were delicious either way.

Try our classic banana split and conduct your own research. No eye chart required.
